stem: Which answer is supported by the passage that includes “Every day, Mr. Lin took the train to work.”?
options: He looked at Ben, who sat next to him.
He always sat by the window and looked at the same fields, houses, and roads.
Leo learned that seeing the same story many times does not always make it true.
On the train to the city, Lily always wanted the window seat.
